description: This file defines interfaces and classes for building and managing schedulable pools within Apache Spark's scheduler, including FIFO and fair scheduling strategies, with configuration parsing from XML files.

classes.name: SchedulableBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building schedulable pools and adding task set managers.

classes.name: FIFOSchedulableBuilder
classes.description: Implementation of SchedulableBuilder using FIFO scheduling.

classes.name: FairSchedulableBuilder
classes.description: Implementation of SchedulableBuilder for fair scheduling, supporting XML configuration.

methods.name: buildPools
methods.description: Builds the pool structure from configuration or defaults.

methods.name: addTaskSetManager
methods.description: Adds a task set manager to the specified pool.

methods.name: buildDefaultPool
methods.description: Creates a default pool if it does not exist.

methods.name: buildFairSchedulerPool
methods.description: Parses XML to create pools for fair scheduling.

methods.name: getSchedulingModeValue
methods.description: Retrieves scheduling mode from XML node, defaults if invalid.

methods.name: getIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves integer property from XML node, defaults if invalid.
